title: Can I Save the World at 30?
overview: It's Liu Yinuo's 30th birthday, and she's still getting yelled at over the phone by her boss at her exploitative company. Tired of it all, she asks for a life-changing event and learns the hard way to be careful what you wish for!

title: If Nobody Finds Out, I'm In
Prison Break! Escape the Underground Cells!
Auto Mode! Let Me Farm XP!
I Think I'm More Suited to Farmwork
How Do You Like the Music?
overview: Faced with the Demons of Song and Knowledge, Enya and Yinuo have to find a way to survive! Meanwhile, Jinjin from the item shop appears before Cherry and Putao.

title: Oh! Better Clear the Beginner Quest
overview: Enya is baffled by Yinuo's utter lack of faith in her and vows to make her respect her. To do that, she has to level by going back to the basics: clearing the beginner quests!

title: Fighting Tournament Begins! Prepare for Stage Clear
overview: The Forest City Fighting Tournament kicks off with some heated battles, and some that aren’t.

title: This Is How the Messiah Fights
overview: Enya's fight with Nagu literally puts everyone to sleep but ends with unexpected results.

title: Emergency Quest: Save Enya!
overview: Enya is captured by a sudden invader. With her life in danger, her invincible Sensei sets out to rescue her.

title: Save Noa
overview: With the Forest City under attack and Yinuo out of the picture, the party and their merry friends must work together to defend their home! Meanwhile, Enya faces an impossible challenge to save Yinuo...
